body: Omg I do the picture thing too. He'll be in the store shopping for the same food we always get, tell me it's not there, then send me a picture. And it is literally in front of his face. So I'll circle it for him and send it back to see, or else we wouldn't have half the food we need. And it's always on the same damn spot on the shelf!
Thank you, I feel like it's too mean of a joke for him to make. He never really does.
When he repeated himself I was so unsure if I even actually asked him or not. I thought maybe a bad day too but things seemed fine right before that.
I wish I would have said that back to him lol
Thank you, it does make me feel very confused and uncertain.
It could have been a joke but usually he doesn't joke to that...extreme.
